biggest_catch: This is a new-member-only offer with a 5-year exclusion: you must not have had any RFCU account within the past 1,826 days (5 years), and the share savings and checking accounts must be opened on the same day.
catches: Offer valid June 2 – October 3, 2026; accounts must be opened by October 3, 2026.

New members only: the new primary savings (membership) and checking account must be the first RFCU accounts — no RFCU account within the past 1826 days (5 years). Members who are joint on another account opening their first primary savings + checking are eligible.
The new primary savings and checking accounts must be opened on the same day.
Open a share savings account to join; a $5.00 minimum balance is required to open and must be maintained in the share savings account at all times.

Within the first 60 days of checking account opening: set up and log in to Redstone online banking at least once AND make at least 5 point-of-sale purchase transactions with the debit card associated with the new checking account (ATM withdrawals do not count).
Participating member must be 13 years old or older; consumer accounts only; business accounts are not included.
The valid promotional code must be entered at the time of account opening; cannot be combined with any other promotional offers.

Participant must be a resident of select counties: Alabama — Cullman, Jackson, Limestone, Marshall, DeKalb, Lawrence, Morgan, plus select zip codes in Blount, Etowah, Jefferson, Lauderdale, and Winston counties; Tennessee — Bedford, Cannon, Lincoln, Moore, Rutherford, Davidson, Williamson, plus select zip codes in Coffee, De Kalb, Franklin, Giles, Lawrence, Marshall, Maury, Wilson, and Sumner counties. Must reside in the participating county until the bonus is paid.
The promotion code cannot be used more than two times per household; limited to one bonus per participating member.
Employees and family members of RFCU and its affiliates are not eligible.
The recipient is solely responsible for any personal tax liability arising out of acceptance of this incentive.
$25 minimum opening deposit for any checking account; no minimum balance required to obtain the bonus.
Bonus is deposited into the member's checking account within 150 days of account opening, but no later than March 2, 2027; accounts must remain open and in good standing until the bonus is paid.
Checking monthly maintenance fees (waivable): Rewards Checking $8, Easy Checking $3, Safeguard Checking $10; no monthly maintenance fee for any checking account if the primary owner is 24 or younger.

steps: Confirm you reside in a participating AL or TN county and have not had any RFCU account in the past 5 years.

Between June 2 and October 3, 2026, become a new Redstone member: open a share savings account and a checking account on the same day (online or in-branch), entering the valid promotional code at account opening.
Within the first 60 days, log in to Redstone online banking at least once and make at least 5 point-of-sale purchases with the new debit card (ATM withdrawals don't count).
Keep both accounts open and in good standing and continue residing in the participating county until the bonus is paid.
Receive $475 in the checking account within 150 days of opening (no later than March 2, 2027).
Set aside tax obligations, since the recipient is solely responsible for personal tax liability on the incentive.
timing: Accounts opened by 10/3/2026; qualifying activities within the first 60 days; bonus deposited within 150 days of account opening, no later than 3/2/2027.
